"This chart illustrates the percentage of cost recovery for electricity prices (PEST) across different user categories and timeframes/scenarios.

### **Chart Details**
*   **Title:** Electricity Prices (PEST) Cost Recovery 1/
*   **Unit of Measurement:** Percent (%)
*   **Y-Axis:** 0 to 140 in increments of 20.
*   **X-Axis Categories:** 
    1. High Income Households and Commercial Users
    2. Low/Middle Income Households 2/

### **Data Breakdown**

| User Category | Feb-Apr (%) | Jun-Jul (no policy change) (%) | Jun-Jul (Res. 93/2024) (%) |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| High Income Households and Commercial Users | 100 | ~63 | 80 |
| Low/Middle Income Households 2/ | ~7 | ~4 | 30 |

### **Summary of Findings**
*   **High Income/Commercial Users:** Cost recovery was at 100% in the Feb-Apr period. Without policy changes, it would have dropped to approximately 63% in Jun-Jul, but under Resolution 93/2024, it reached 80%.
*   **Low/Middle Income Households:** Cost recovery is significantly lower for this group. It was approximately 7% in Feb-Apr and would have fallen to roughly 4% without policy changes. Under Resolution 93/2024, cost recovery increased to 30%.

***

**Background/Non Chart:** The second provided image contains text and additional charts regarding "Recent Developments and Policies" in Argentina, which were not included in this extraction per instructions."
